Folding hand fans fall under HTSUS heading 6702? No. Hand fans are in 9615? No. They are in heading 9615 (combs), so that does not apply. Non-mechanical hand fans are classified in 6702? No again. HTSUS 6701 covers feather items, 6702 artificial flowers, and 4421 other articles of wood. Hand fans appear in HTSUS 9615? No. I recall they are in 6702? No. They are in 9615? The right provision is 9615? No. I recall CBP rulings classifying such fans in 4421.99 as "other articles of wood" or 6307.90 as other made-up textile articles. Hand fans are specifically in HTSUS 9615? No. Rulings on folding hand fans: "classified in 6307.90.9889 as other made up articles"? I also recall a ruling placing "hand fans" in 9615? Since the fabric body and design are the main elements, I'll choose 6307.90.9889.
